rules: Autonomous factions use the same conserved recruitment, market, travel, combat, contract, recovery and training laws as player-linked factions.
Routine choices are deterministic functions of current saved resources, capacity, knowledge, relationships and pressure. No random drama action table.
A faction cannot execute an action it cannot fund, staff, reach or lawfully know about.
Outlaw aggression is evaluated only when a physically relevant route frontier is active; diplomacy changes only through explicit proposals.
